name: Omni View Top World News
tagline: The ten stories that matter most today, anywhere.
description: Omni View Top World News ranks the ten stories that matter most anywhere in the world today — by how many people they change something for, how much and how soon — drawing on the world's newsrooms and the network's five regional desks, which publish earlier each morning. Then one contested question with the strongest case on each side, and one measurable sign of progress. Read by Mira, the Nerra Network's AI host — the stories are chosen and written by software from named newsrooms, every item names its source, and every claim is attributed.
